document.abstract: A piece of apparatus is described by means of which it is possible to develop, fix, wash, and dry pictures on 35-mm film in four seconds. Integral with the apparatus is a camera lens with which the pictures are formed and a projection system with which they are projected. Though the particular device has been designed for radar photography, it is believed to have a variety of other uses and applications.
